items.html: Therefore, at that time ZA was in the secret of Neshama, which is Bina, and his Nukva was in the secret of Ruach, which is ZA. And on this matter it is said there, in the Saba of Mishpatim, folio 99, col. 2, concerning the matter of "the candle of God is the soul of man": that the Neshama is the male of the great supernal tree, and the Ruach is the female of the small tree.
